source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max((c for c in range(10) if c != 2), key=lambda c: sum(v == c for row in grid for v in row))
    # The full 2-colored row or column is the boundary.
    if any(all(v == 2 for v in row) for row in grid):
        axis = 0
        boundary = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 2 for v in row))
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    else:
        axis = 1
        boundary = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))
        obj = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = grid[obj[0][0]][obj[0][1]]
    if axis == 0:
        lo, hi = min(r for r, c in obj), max(r for r, c in obj)
        delta = boundary - 1 - hi if hi < boundary else boundary + 1 - lo
        for r, c in obj:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in obj:
            out[r + delta][c] = color
        stripe = min(r for r, c in obj) + delta - 1 if delta > 0 else max(r for r, c in obj) + delta + 1
        out[stripe] = [8] * w
    else:
        lo, hi = min(c for r, c in obj), max(c for r, c in obj)
        delta = boundary - 1 - hi if hi < boundary else boundary + 1 - lo
        for r, c in obj:
            out[r][c] = bg
        for r, c in obj:
            out[r][c + delta] = color
        stripe = min(c for r, c in obj) + delta - 1 if delta > 0 else max(c for r, c in obj) + delta + 1
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][stripe] = 8
    return out
'''
